components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Load and Play actions use complete inversion.

components.name: Environment Navigation
components.description: Three contiguous operating depths with inversion for the active mode.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid #fff}.ds-nav button{min-height:44px;border:0;border-right:1px solid #fff;border-radius:0;background:#000;color:#fff;font:600 .7rem/1 Bahnschrift,Arial Narrow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.09em}.ds-nav button:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-nav button:hover,.ds-nav .is-active{background:#fff;color:#000}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Material Specimen
components.description: A tactile audible material sample with a functional barcode signature.

components.name: Framed Station
components.description: Flat operational containment; never a floating card.
components.css: .ds-station{padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);border-radius:0;background:#000;color:#fff}.ds-station h3{margin:0 0 16px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);font:600 .72rem/1.2 Bahnschrift,Arial Narrow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em}.ds-station p{margin:0;font:400 15px/1.45 Bahnschrift,Arial Narrow,sans-serif}

components.name: Analysis Hatch
components.description: The threshold between musical operation and mathematical study.
components.css: .ds-analysis{display:flex;width:100%;min-height:74px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:0;background:#fff;color:#000;text-align:left}.ds-analysis span{font:500 1.5rem/1 Bahnschrift,Arial Narrow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.055em}.ds-analysis small{font:500 .65rem/1.3 Cascadia Mono,Consolas,monospace}.ds-analysis b{font:400 2rem/1 Cascadia Mono,Consolas,monospace}.ds-analysis:hover{background:#000;color:#fff}.ds-analysis:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: RayDrone behaves like a live acoustic field made operable. Its waveform is the dominant object and every control reads as a calibrated part of that field. Expression never obscures operation.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black and white with state expressed by inversion.
Hairline frames, barcode density and sine lattices used functionally.
One dominant signal field followed by material specimens and parameter bays.
Mathematical analysis is a separate advanced destination.
Dense information remains aligned, tabular and keyboard-operable.

rules.name: The Binary Field Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome uses only pure black and pure white; no gray ramps, gradients, glow or colored accents.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Active, selected and primary states invert foreground and background instead of introducing a new color.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Values align tabularly and never compete with larger action labels.

rules.name: The Flat Signal Rule
rules.body: A control may invert or strengthen its frame in response to state; it never lifts off the surface.

dos: Do make the live signal the largest visual object in the first viewport.
Do preserve familiar buttons, inputs, keyboard focus and readable labels.
Do use barcode texture to communicate activity, progress or selection.
Do reduce information density deliberately across breakpoints.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, glass, glow, gradients or neon.
Don't imitate a hardware synth with decorative knobs.
Don't hide primary instrument controls behind tabs or dropdown navigation.
Don't place mathematical analysis inside the main creative flow.
